description: J-EX9 example. A first-order process (K = 1, tau = 1 s) behind a 0.2 s TransportDelay, under a 10 ms DiscretePI (Kp = 2, Ti = 1 s, +-5) whose command passes a 2-sample IntegerDelay; the measurement adds seeded normal noise (std 0.02, seed 42, 1 ms). The setpoint steps to 1 at 0.5 s, so the step reaches the process at 0.72 s. Before that the process only sees the controller's reaction to the noise.

checks.note: dead time: before 0.5 + 0.02 + 0.2 s the process only follows the PI's reaction to the measurement noise (measured max 0.0027)
the delayed step has arrived: 0.0082 at 0.725 s, 0.16 at 0.8 s
the PI settles the process at the setpoint despite the noise (measured 0.9943; 1.0061 at 2 s, peak 1.0134)
the measurement noise has the configured std 0.02 (measured RMS 0.0200008 over 6000 samples)
bit-exact noise: tick 1000 draws sample 999 of stream 42, std * noise_normal(42, 999) (spec 'Seeded noise and delay'); the exported FMU draws the same double
